Every ship in that facing at PB, Short or Medium range makes a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw, taking 26d6 thunder damage on a failed save, or half as much on a success. Guided: friendly ships make the save with advantage. Holds 2 volleys. After each volley the rack must recharge (5–6) before it fires again; an empty rack reloads 2 more from a Missile Rack Magazine (Gargantuan) as part of that recharge.

Defense: against missiles and torpedoes coming from its facing, the ship makes its saves against Missile Rack volleys with advantage, and missile and torpedo attack rolls against it have disadvantage. Does not stack with another Point Defense on the same facing, and does not work while that facing is disabled.
